question: Can an explicit positive energy law couple an internal scalar heart to actual shell dilation and stable cell-volume breathing?
assumptions: New mechanical state: one internal preferred strain a and four radial shell strains q_i, not the29-chain state.
Fixed centre; R_i=(1+q_i)r_i on regular reference rays; q_i>-1; angular/shear motion excluded.
Chosen quadratic kinetic/potential law with Ih,Is,Kc>0, Kh,Ks,Kt>=0 and Kh+Ks>0.
Equal spoke and shell coefficients give exact S4 symmetry; material and native parameter selection OPEN.
Dimensionless u, model energy coefficients and optional L; physical time/energy calibration OPEN.

Heart-only strain produces V_i=V0*(1+b)^3/4 in the symmetric sector, with b_doubleprime(0)=Kc*a0/Is. Collective determinant D0=Kh*Ks+Kh*Kc+4*Kc*Ks>0 proves stability.
